paragraphs.normal_text: Thoracic aorta: Ascending aorta 34 mm. Arch and descending thoracic aorta of normal calibre. No dissection.

paragraphs.name: Iliofemoral access
paragraphs.normal_text:
Iliofemoral access (minimal luminal diameter):
Right: CIA 8.3 mm, EIA 7.6 mm, CFA 8.0 mm.
Left: CIA 8.1 mm, EIA 7.2 mm, CFA 7.7 mm.
Calcification: mild, non-circumferential. Tortuosity: mild. No dissection or flow-limiting stenosis.

paragraphs.name: Lungs and airways
paragraphs.normal_text: Lungs and airways: No suspicious pulmonary nodule. No consolidation. Airways patent.

paragraphs.normal_text: Pleura and pericardium: No pleural or pericardial effusion.

paragraphs.normal_text: Mediastinum: No mediastinal or hilar lymphadenopathy.

paragraphs.name: Upper abdomen
paragraphs.normal_text: Upper abdomen: Unremarkable within the limits of an arterial phase study.

paragraphs.name: Conclusion
paragraphs.normal_text:
1. Iliofemoral access favourable for a transfemoral approach bilaterally; minimal luminal diameter right 7.6 mm, left 7.2 mm.
2. No significant incidental extracardiac finding.

Annular sizing, valve morphology, coronary ostial heights and aortic root measurements are reported separately in the structural heart report; please refer to that report for valve planning.

expected_per_dictation.notes: Multi-rule case. Left EIA 5.1 mm triggers the three access rules: the negative becomes 'No dissection.', item 1 loses the favourable wording, and the alternative-access sentence goes before the fixed structural-report block. The 7 mm RUL nodule triggers SUPPRESS and APPEND in Lungs, with 'No other pulmonary nodule.' beside it (IF_PRESENT, stored only). The Conclusion needs a numbered nodule item instead of P17. Technique slots: 65 ml, DLP 690.
Normal study. Every NORMAL and NEGATIVE stands, the Conclusion is the favourable access item plus P17, then P2. Technique slots: 80 ml, DLP 640.

Tricky case. The dictation says 'infrarenal aorta 34 mm max AP' and never uses the word aneurysm. A 34 mm infrarenal aorta is aneurysmal (≥30 mm), so P7 must be OMITTED, the AAA surveillance APPEND applies, and P17 is contradicted. Second trap: the 3 mm RML nodule is below threshold, so P22 and P23 are NOT met and 'No suspicious pulmonary nodule.' stands, as in example 05. All access minimal luminal diameters are ≥6.6 mm, so the access rules are not met.
